messages.author: 352166904028c0ad
messages.subject: downloadHandler() and Windows
parts:
Hi,

I am developing a ShinyApp right now. We are currently in testing with the App. For development I am working with rstudio on MacOS. Everything works fine. We have a calculation depending on some input and a download Button for the results.
When I copy the App to the computer of a friend - running with Windows, same version of R and Rstudio - everything works just fine - only the download is not working. The file dialog opens but no file is saved.

Any ideas? I have no clue ....

Thanks
Michael

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: downloadHandler() and Windows
parts:
Note the download button does not work in the RStudio viewer. Your
friend might be using the RStudio viewer to view the app. If that is
the case, please open the app in the external web browser (there is a
drop-down list on the right of the "Run App" button: Run in Window,
Run in Viewer Pane, Run External; choose the last one). Otherwise
please report your RStudio and shiny versions.

Regards,
Yihui
